page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, Hebrew headwords set in large type at the start of each entry. Running head centred at the top. Page number at top left. Catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: שרג Pyh. שרג Perplexum esse; Implicâri. Futur. ישרגו Implexi sunt, Job.40.12. Hithp. Futur. ישתרגו Implicantur, Contorquentur, Thren.1.14.
שריגים m.p. Propagines, Surculi, Palmites: sic dicti, quòd Implicari soleant, Gen.40.10.12. Aff. שריגיה Palmites ejus, Joël.1.7.
שרך Superesse, Residuum esse, vel manere: Præter. והשרידים שרדו מהם Et superstites qui supererant ex eis, Jos.10.20.
שריד m. Superstes, Residuus, Residuum, Num.21.36. Plural. ut ante: Aff. שרידיו Superstites ejus, Job.27.15.
שרד m. Amusis, filum mensorium fabrorum lignariorum, Jesa.44.13.

שרד m. Ministerium, Exod.31.10. & 39.41. Chaldæis שמושא quod idem. Intelliguntur Panni vel Mappæ ministerii sacri, quibus tegebatur Arca & Mensa, & Candelabrum, ac proinde similes erant cortinis aut velis, quæ Chaldaicè dicuntur סרדין. R.Sal.
שרה Solvere, Dimittere, Emittere; & est Chaldæum, idem quod ante שרא. Futur. ישרהו Solvit, Solutum emittit illud, Job.37.3. Alii, Dirigit illud; quasi sit à ישר. Nomen שרותך Vide in שאר.
שריון m. Idem, 1.Sam.17.38. Cum ם vide in סרה. Plur. והשריניים Et loricæ, Nehem.4.16. Fœmin. ושריניות 2.Par.26.14.

שרון Scharon, Proprium nomen regionis campestris pascuosissimæ, 1.Chron.5.16. & 27.29. & alibi. Fuit & vini optimi ferax, unde יין השרוני Vinum Scharoniti-cum, cui duas partes aquæ immiscebant: Schabbath fol.77. Nidda fol.19.

page.notes: Hebrew headwords and forms were read from the scan; the vowel points are small and some may be misread, notably the headword of the entry on Ministerium (שרד, possibly שרד with a different vowel), the Chaldean word שמושא, the plural/feminine forms in the entry for שריון (ושריניות), and the Chaldean word סרדין. Italic and roman type was judged from the scan and may not be exact. The running head and catchword are Hebrew and were kept as printed. The word "Scharoniticum" is hyphenated across the line as "Scharoniti-cum". "Pyh." and "Perplexum" and other abbreviations are printed as shown. No marginal notes on this page.
